description: From fz-9gp (2026-07-15). Spec enforcement is now keyed on the CALLSITEs code being non-bootstrap: user-written calls are always enforced; library-internal callsites are not -- because activation evidence at shared library bodies currently JOINS uncorrelated users (proven: Enum.to_list(1..7//2) + Enum.to_list(%{1=>:a}) pairs Ranges reducer with Maps element type -- a combination no runtime call makes; the matcher verdict was CORRECT on phantom evidence, span inside enum.fz, unactionable). The 3 affected lib tests are the witness set (range_and_map_to_list, f98_orbit, capture_abi_correlated). RETIREMENT CONDITION: when the correlation-loss architecture is fixed (the fz-463 / CallSiteTargets-split arc, or per-callsite evidence keying), delete the caller-side gate from function_contract_is_enforced and verify those 3 tests stay green under full uniform enforcement. Also then re-examine the conservative skips (var-carrying clause domains) in the arrow-set coverage. NOTE: joined-ness is not currently marked on evidence -- the third option (enforce-unless-joined) has no cheap detection; that detection IS the fz-463 arc.
title: enforce specs at library-internal callsites once activation evidence is correlation-sound -- the caller-side enforcement boundary retires with the fz-463 arc
